name: Alfons Åberg ”Bara överallt!”
storyline:
It looks like a completely ordinary day. Alfons Åberg gets up and plays for a while. Dad shouts that it's time to eat lunch and soon it will be evening and bedtime. But in the imagination there are no ordinary days. "I'm just gonna", says Alfons Åberg, and then anything can happen. Hangers turn into snails and paintbrushes into angels. The glass bowl becomes a temple, dad's shoe a spaceship and the fish sticks become dominoes.

You play and fantasize with Alfons and his dad - and Mållgan of course. Alfons' best friends Viktor and Milla are happy to come and play and you can go to grandma's house and play with the older cousins. A total of 17 different games!
summary: 17 different mini games with the Gunilla Bergström character Alfons Åberg.
